post_text:
In 2019, five cities looked identical.
Memphis. Cleveland. Detroit. Baltimore. Fresno.
Same size. Same poverty. Same absenteeism rate.

By 2024 — completely different outcomes.

Cleveland dropped from 22% to 18%.
Detroit dropped from 24% to 19%.
Memphis went from 20% to 29.6%.

Same starting point. Opposite directions.

I built a dashboard to find out why.

---

Day 9 of 10.

→ 5-city trend lines 2019–2024 — side by side
→ Intervention explorer — what each recovering city actually did
→ AI finding — the 3 interventions that appear in every city that improved
→ Full comparison table — all metrics, all cities

The cities that recovered didn't spend more.
They targeted differently.
Attendance liaisons. Community partnerships. Reentry programs for chronically absent students.

Memphis has 78 attendance liaisons and $4.4M invested.
The data suggests the investment is not yet showing up in outcomes.

All data from NCES TUDA + EDFacts. Free to download.

Final day tomorrow — 10 findings, one report.

📊 Full interactive dashboard → link in first comment 👇
